reply.text:
Verified end-to-end against the live server: client-side validation blocks a bad submit and shows `error-quantity`/`error-customer`, a valid submit creates order `901` via `POST /api/orders`, and the form clears on success.

**Summary of changes** — added an `orders` module following the existing devices module's contract/adapter/context pattern:
- `services/orders.contract.ts` — `OrdersApi` interface (`customers`, `createOrder`), `OrderRejected` error carrying field errors
- `services/orders.http.ts` — real `fetch` adapter for `/api/customers` and `/api/orders`, translating a 422 into `OrderRejected`
- `services/orders.context.ts` — `useOrdersApi()`, same pattern as `useDeviceApi()`
- `modules/orders/orders.queries.ts` — `useCustomers()` query, `useCreateOrder()` mutation
- `modules/orders/orders.validation.ts` (+ test) — pure client-side validation (customer chosen, integer quantity 1–1000, note ≤200 chars), field keys matching the server's (`customer`/`quantity`/`note`)
- `modules/orders/OrderForm.tsx` + `orders.css` + `index.ts` — the form itself: `data-testid="order-form"`, per-field `data-testid="error-<field>"`, `data-testid="submit"` disabled while `createOrder.isPending`, `data-testid="created"` showing the new id on success, form reset on success
- Wired into `main.tsx` alongside the existing `Devices` module, and imported in `styles/global.css`

`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` all pass (26 tests, including 4 new validation tests).
